entry.title: CommunityToolkit/Aspire - Releases - 2026-11-20
entry.content:
v17.0.0

This release aligns the Community Toolkit with Aspire 17.0.0 and adds .NET 11 support.

Highlights

  • New integrations: Added hosting integrations for AI Agents, Flare, Loki, and Tempo, plus hosting and client integrations for vLLM.
  • Polyglot AppHosts: Added Go AppHost examples and parity coverage, and expanded SQL Database Projects support for polyglot AppHosts.
  • Aspire 17 compatibility: Migrated C# AppHosts from the obsolete Aspire SDK and updated integration APIs for Aspire 17.
  • Improved integration behavior: Host addresses now use Aspire endpoint resolution; Perl resources trust Aspire-configured custom CAs and developer certificates by default; OpenTelemetry Collector routing handles HTTP exporter protocols; and Floci Service Bus host ports are allocated dynamically.
  • Bacon on stable Aspire: The Bacon hosting integration is available in the renamed CommunityToolkit.Aspire.Hosting.Rust.Extensions package, without depending on the prerelease Aspire Rust package.

Upgrade notes

  • Update CommunityToolkit.Aspire package references to 17.0.0 and align your AppHost with Aspire 17.0.0.
  • The Toolkit's Go and Java hosting integrations were removed after being upstreamed to Aspire; use Aspire's integrations instead.
  • The Toolkit Bacon integration package is now named CommunityToolkit.Aspire.Hosting.Rust.Extensions (previously CommunityToolkit.Aspire.Hosting.Rust).
